# lcd.setWindowTitle

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.4.6</span></div>

Set the window title.

```lua
lcd.setWindowTitle(text[, color])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes | title |
| `color` | number | optional | title color |

## Returns

Nothing.
